messages:
tomas: heads-up: saw a spike in private-endpoint handshakes during a customer bulk-onboard that led to transient 504s on CP. looking for quick mitigation + long-term plan.

jen: saw it too. agents retry loop has no jitter and cert rotations coincided. queue depth on CP skyrocketed.

sara: we have attach_errors up 6x and handshake latency tail at ~3s. bulk job started ~09:12 and lasted ~8m.

michael: short-term: throttle onboarding job. medium-term: agent-side jittered exp backoff + token caching. long-term: rethink handshake circuit (async attach confirmation).

jen: concrete: add exp backoff with randomized jitter (base 200ms, max 5s, cap attempts 8). keep a tiny in-memory tenant token cache TTL 8s to avoid repeated introspection.

tomas: token cache ok if we can invalidate immediately on revocation/key rotation. must wire CP to push invalidate events.

carmen: operator constraint: we need deterministic invalidation path. propose tenant.invalidate pubsub topic and a lightweight invalidate endpoint on agents.

infra-bot: current handshake payload for reference: POST /handshake 
Headers: Authorization: Bearer <token>, X-Tenant-ID: <tenant> 
Body: { agent_id, agent_version }

sara: telemetry requests: emit counter attach_attempts{tenant}, attach_failures{tenant,reason}, histogram handshake_latency_ms with buckets [50,100,250,500,1000,3000,10000]. sample traces at 0.5% overall and 100% for failures above 500ms.

michael: fallback behavior: after N failed backoffs (configurable per-tenant), mark endpoint degraded and divert traffic to regional-relay as best-effort. this must be opt-out for tenants with strict network controls.

jen: logging format suggestion for failures: single-line structured JSON: {"ts":"<iso>","event":"handshake_fail","tenant":"t-123","agent":"a-1","err":"sig_mismatch","attempt":4,"backoff_ms":800} 
(we'll stringify in agent runtime).

sara: add invalidate log: {"ts":"...","event":"invalidate_cache","tenant":"t-123","reason":"key_rotate"}. dashboards should surface invalidate rate per-tenant.

michael: test plan: synthetic agent harness that can spawn 10k concurrent attaches with controlled cert rotation events to validate backoff, cache invalidation, and fallback tagging. will run on a dev cluster and capture CP metrics.

carmen: ops playbook: when invalidate spikes, run key-rotate incident checklist and ensure pubsub is delivering. include steps to quarantine tenants if large-scale misuse.

tomas: owners and next steps: sara -> telemetry schema + dashboards, jen -> backoff lib & agent patch, michael -> fallback relay flow + console tagging, carmen -> invalidate event API and ops runbook. i'll open a PR to update the handshake contract and include metric/log names.

infra-bot: CI checks: RFC branch passes static checks, no infra blockers.

sara: aiming to post RFC follow-up with schema + runbook by EOD tomorrow.

tomas: nice work. schedule a short design review once RFC is up. :thumbsup:
